one_liner_zh: 科林研發最新季度財報表現強勁，受惠於半導體設備需求成長，營收與每股盈餘皆優於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Lam Research reported strong quarterly earnings, driven by robust semiconductor equipment demand, beating top and bottom-line estimates.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 1.82 美元優於預期的 1.68 美元，營收年增 29.99% 至 67.2 億美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘 (EPS) 達 1.82 美元，優於市場預期的 1.68 美元。
季度營收達 67.2 億美元，較去年同期顯著成長 29.99%。
受惠於先進邏輯與記憶體製程設備需求，獲利能力持續擴張。
highlights_en: Quarterly revenue reached $6.72 billion, marking a 29.99% year-over-year growth.
Profitability expanded, driven by strong demand for advanced logic and memory manufacturing equipment.
risks_zh: 本益比處於 52.10 的相對高位，估值壓力偏高。
全球半導體資本支出週期循環與地緣政治供應鏈變數。
risks_en: Trailing P/E ratio stands at 52.10, indicating elevated valuation pressure.
Cyclicality in global semiconductor capital expenditures and geopolitical supply chain uncertainties.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：訊號偏向正面，顯示半導體設備復甦力道穩健。對股價短中期而言，強勁基本面提供支撐，但高本益比可能限制估值擴張空間。後續需追蹤主要晶圓廠的資本支出計畫與出貨動能。
ai_view_en: view: Positive signal indicating solid recovery momentum in semiconductor equipment. For the near to mid-term, strong fundamentals support the stock, though a high P/E ratio may limit valuation expansion. Track major foundries' capital expenditure plans and shipment momentum going forward.
